name: Sticky Salted Caramel Apple Wedges with Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: Place water in a large pot. Add sugar, gently stir to combine, and place over medium-high heat. Cook, without stirring, until sugar begins to turn light golden in places, 7-9 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
89 ml (⅜ cup) water
1 ½ cup granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cream, butter, and salt in small saucepan; place over medium heat. Cook just until butter is melted and cream is heated through (do not boil), 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml heavy cream
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop peanuts and set aside.

When the sugar begins to turn golden, gently swirl the saucepan in a circular motion to distribute the caramelization. Return to the heat and continue to cook, swirling occasionally, until the entire mixture is bright amber in color, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Slowly add the warm cream mixture, a few tablespoons at a time, to the saucepan with the caramelized sugar, whisking after each addition (be careful, the sugar mixture will bubble vigorously). Once all of the cream is added, continue to whisk until smooth; set aside.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; slice each quarter into wedges.
To serve, divide apple wedges between plates. Drizzle with warm caramel sauce and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!
